name: WebBrowserInstance
label: WebBrowserInstance
description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

name: UiElement
label: UiElement
description: Select the UI element on the web page to capture.

name: ExtractionParameter
label: ExtractionParameter
description: The parameters to use when extracting data. Depending on the extraction mode, this parameter accepts different data.

name: MaxWebPagesToProcess
label: MaxWebPagesToProcess
description: The maximum number of web pages to process.

name: SendPhysicalClickForNextPage
label: SendPhysicalClickForNextPage
description: Send physical click for next page navigation.

name: PageCssSelector
label: PageCssSelector
description: CSS selector used to identify the pagination element.

name: ExtractionMode
label: ExtractionMode
description: Specify what to extract from the web page.

selectOptions.label: Single Value
selectOptions.description: Extracts a single value from the webpage.

selectOptions.label: Entire HTML Table
selectOptions.description: Extracts the entire HTML table structure.

name: UsePaging
label: UsePaging
description: Specify whether to use paging during extraction.

name: GetAllWebPages
label: GetAllWebPages
description: Specify whether to extract all available web pages.

name: ProcessDataUponExtraction
label: ProcessDataUponExtraction
description: Specify whether to process extracted data to match visual display (e.g., handling hidden elements). Not recommended for large datasets.

name: TimeOut
label: TimeOut
description: Set the time in seconds to wait for the extraction before it fails.

name: StoreDataMode
label: StoreDataMode
description: Specify whether to store the extracted data in a variable or an Excel spreadsheet.

selectOptions.label: Variable
selectOptions.description: Stores extracted data in a variable.

selectOptions.label: Excel Spreadsheet
selectOptions.description: Stores extracted data in an Excel spreadsheet.

name: OExcelInstanceOutput
label: OExcelInstanceOutput
description: The Excel instance with the extracted data. Use this instance to manipulate the spreadsheet.

name: ODataFromWebPageOutput
label: ODataFromWebPageOutput
description: The extracted data in the form of a single value, list, data row, or data table.
